lead_raw_text:
The structure of Bi12O15 (reduced formula Bi8O10) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 27 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Bi centers in two environments: a 6-coordinate octahedral motif and a 5-coordinate trigonal bipyramidal motif, with O centers showing 3- or 4-coordinate environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 27 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Bi octahedra and between O octahedra, plus edge-sharing between Bi octahedra and trigonal bipyramids.
